sets.sql: SELECT PerformedByID AS ManagerID,ActivityType,COUNT_BIG(*) AS ActivityCount FROM dbo.ServiceRequestActivity WHERE PerformedByRole='MANAGER' AND ActivityAt>=@FromDate AND ActivityAt<@ToDate GROUP BY PerformedByID,ActivityType ORDER BY PerformedByID,ActivityType OFFSET (@Page-1)*@PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
